description: This bar chart, titled "Text Generation with Diffusion Language Models: A Pre-training Approach with Continuous Paragraph Denoise," illustrates the performance metrics for three different evaluation methods—ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L—across four distinct "Step" values (100, 250, 500, 1000, and 2000) on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis represents the score values, which are displayed as numerical labels atop each bar and range from 0 to approximately 42, with no explicit scale or unit indicated. The chart employs a grouped bar format, with each "Step" category containing three adjacent bars: ROUGE-1 is represented by a blue bar with diagonal stripes, ROUGE-2 by a solid gray bar, and ROUGE-L by an orange bar with a dotted pattern. The bars are sorted in descending order by their height within each group, with ROUGE-1 consistently being the tallest bar, followed by ROUGE-L, and then ROUGE-2. The values for each bar are explicitly labeled: at Step 100, the scores are 6.3 (ROUGE-1), 0.1 (ROUGE-2), and 3.0 (ROUGE-L); at Step 250, they are 11.6 (ROUGE-1), 0.4 (ROUGE-2), and 8.3 (ROUGE-L); at Step 500, they are 21.1 (ROUGE-1), 4.1 (ROUGE-2), and 15.9 (ROUGE-L); at Step 1000, they are 38.3 (ROUGE-1), 16.5 (ROUGE-2), and 30.7 (ROUGE-L); and at Step 2000, they are 41.2 (ROUGE-1), 19.1 (ROUGE-2), and 33.4 (ROUGE-L). The legend in the top-left corner identifies the color and pattern for each ROUGE variant.
